results.name: unit_update_weapon_selection_by_name
results.evidence: Resolves two name-table indices via PTR_DAT_00687130+0x28 into weapon object ids, compares against the unit's current weapon (FUN_00569970) and on mismatch updates the seat/weapon mapping (FUN_0056d6e0) or drops the weapon (FUN_0056dec0); the `*(int*)*in_EAX==0` / FUN_004ec590 else FUN_004ec670 dispatch pattern mirrors FUN_00572110.
results.summary: Script/console-callable helper that resolves weapon-name arguments to object ids and updates or drops the unit's selected weapon accordingly.

results.name: unit_drop_current_weapon
results.evidence: Clears weapon slot 0x2f8[cur] and index 0x2f2 after invoking FUN_0056ed00 (the hand-detach/throw helper shared with the unit_drop_item/unit_drop_grenades hint cluster) when the weapon's tag-flags bit0 (offset 0x308) allows dropping, then picks a new desired weapon via FUN_0056dba0.
results.summary: Detaches and drops the unit's current weapon object and selects a replacement desired-weapon slot.

results.name: unit_get_current_weapon_label
results.evidence: cea-pdb hint list includes unit_get_current_weapon_label via the 'unarmed' string; code returns the weapon tag's label field (weapon_object+0x30c) for the unit's current weapon (0x2f2 index into 0x2f8 array) or the literal "unarmed" if none is held.
results.summary: Returns a label string for the unit's currently held weapon, or "unarmed" if no weapon is equipped.

results.name: unit_get_grenade_count
results.evidence: Reads a byte from unit+0x31e+index (in_CX), the same per-grenade-type ammo-count array decremented two entries at a time by FUN_0056ef60 (unit_drop_grenades) and tested against unit+0x31c (current grenade type) in FUN_0056e080.
results.summary: Returns the ammo count for a given grenade-type slot (index in CX) held by the unit.

results.name: unit_get_current_grenade_index
results.evidence: Reads unit+0x31c, the selected-grenade-type field also tested by unit_get_grenade_count (0x31e array) and by FUN_0056e080's grenade-switch logic.
results.summary: Returns the index of the unit's currently selected grenade type.

results.name: unit_begin_throw_grenade
results.evidence: Validates the unit's control state via FUN_004c2f30, then sets the throw-state machine field (0x28d=1) and a duration counter (0xa4) derived from the unit's animation graph, records aim vectors via FUN_005704d0, and fires an hs/event id (FUN_00492730(0x11)) — consistent with initiating a grenade throw sequence tied to the 0x31c/0x31e grenade-type fields.
results.summary: Initiates the unit's grenade-throw sequence: validates the current mode, records timing/aim data, and starts the throw animation state machine.

results.name: unit_throw_grenade_move_to_hand
results.evidence: cea-pdb hint list includes unit_throw_grenade_move_to_hand via the 'left hand' string; code spawns a grenade projectile object (object_new_with_datum_role_control role 3) and attaches it to the unit's "left hand" marker (object_attach_to_object), storing the new object id in the throw-state field 0x294 and advancing state byte 0x28d to 2.
results.summary: Spawns the grenade projectile object for a throw and attaches it to the unit's left-hand marker, advancing the throw-state machine.

results.name: unit_release_thrown_grenade
results.evidence: Validates throw-state 0x28d==2, computes launch position/velocity via a marker table (DAT_00746fa0+0x174) and random spread, detaches the held grenade object (field 0xa5) via FUN_004f6610/FUN_004f7b70, applies the impulse (FUN_004bef80), sets throw-state to 3 (thrown) and notifies the network layer (FUN_004f5bd0) if not host.
results.summary: Detaches the grenade previously attached to the unit's hand, computes its launch velocity, and releases it into the world, ending the throw-state sequence.

results.name: unit_update_look_delta_controls
results.evidence: Computes a delta between successive marker/position samples (0x17-0x22 vs cached 0x34c-0x354 basis) projected onto the previous sample and clamps the three resulting scalars to [0,1] at offsets 0xdc-0xde, matching the pattern of animation-control accumulator fields used elsewhere in this module (see unit_calculate_animation_controls).
results.summary: Updates a set of clamped 0-1 control values representing the frame-to-frame change of a unit's look/aim reference point, for use by the animation system.

results.name: unit_marker_name_to_hand_index
results.evidence: Case-insensitively matches an input string (unaff_EDI) against a fixed 6-entry global string table (PTR_DAT_0069fde4), returning its index or -1; used near the 'left hand' weapon-attachment cluster.
results.summary: Looks up a string in a fixed 6-entry name table and returns the matching index, or -1 if not found.

results.name: unit_set_custom_animation
results.evidence: Writes graph id (param_1) and animation index (param_2) into the custom-animation fields (0xcc/0xd0) also read by unit_get_custom_animation_time_remaining (FUN_005701b0/0x5701b0) and validated in unit_start_user_animation (FUN_005702a0), and resets the frame counter (0xd2) to 0.
results.summary: Sets the unit's active custom animation (graph and index) and resets its playback frame to zero.

results.name: unit_reset_light_effect
results.evidence: Calls FUN_004d48d0(1) then, if a valid effect index (in_ECX) is present, calls FUN_00543ce0(effect,0,1.0,0) — the same 'set effect intensity' call used by light/heat-effect updates elsewhere in this module (e.g. FUN_00574f30, FUN_00575170).
results.summary: Performs an unresolved state reset (FUN_004d48d0) and, if a valid effect index is provided, resets its intensity to full via FUN_00543ce0.

results.name: unit_calculate_luminosity
results.evidence: Computes luminosity using the standard NTSC luma weights (0.299/0.587/0.114) from an RGB triple returned by FUN_004f1c20 and stores it at offset 0x2e0 (plus a secondary value at 0x2e4 via FUN_004f1b30), or copies both from a related object (object_try_and_get(3)) if present.
results.summary: Computes and caches the unit's current light/luminosity value from its RGB color state, or inherits it from a parent/attached object.

results.name: unit_drop_object_from_hand
results.evidence: cea-pdb hints (unit_drop_item / unit_drop_inventory_weapons / unit_drop_grenades) reference this function's 'left hand' string; code detaches object param_2 from the unit's hand marker (FUN_004f6180(param_1,"left hand")) when it was attached there, clears its attachment flags, imparts a randomized toss velocity (FUN_004f6aa0/FUN_004cd1b0), and finishes releasing it via FUN_004f7b70/FUN_004f59d0/FUN_004f5aa0.
results.summary: Detaches a held object (typically a weapon or grenade) from the unit's hand and releases it into the world with a small randomized toss.

results.name: unit_drop_grenades
results.evidence: cea-pdb hint 'unit_drop_grenades'; code iterates the two grenade-type count fields at unit+0x31e, and for each remaining grenade spawns a projectile object (object_new_with_datum_role_control) and drops it via FUN_0056ed00 (unit_drop_object_from_hand).
results.summary: Spawns and drops all of the unit's carried grenades of both types into the world (e.g. on death).

results.name: unit_drop_inventory_weapons
results.evidence: cea-pdb hint 'unit_drop_inventory_weapons'; code iterates the 4 weapon slots (0x2f8) and drops each one other than the current selection via FUN_0056ed00, adjusting the desired-weapon index (0x2f4) and clearing each slot as it is dropped, using the same weapon-array pattern as FUN_00570520.
results.summary: Drops every weapon currently carried in the unit's inventory, clearing each inventory slot as it is dropped.

results.name: unit_trigger_material_hit_effect
results.evidence: Looks up a global material-effect table by index (in_AX) or a per-unit effect field (via the tag pointed to by DAT_0087bc14, offset 0x120) and calls FUN_00543ce0(effect,-1,1.0,0) to trigger it at full intensity; called by unit_cause_melee_damage and unit_melee_attack_scan after a successful hit.
results.summary: Triggers a material/impact visual effect associated with a given material index or the current unit, used after melee hits.

results.name: unit_cause_melee_damage
results.evidence: cea-pdb hint 'unit_cause_melee_damage' via the 'melee' string; code finds the unit's melee marker (FUN_004f6080(param_1,"melee",...)), performs a hit test (FUN_00505880) or falls back to the raw hand position, then calls object_apply_damage or damage_apply_area_effect against the resolved target and optionally FUN_0056f210 to play the impact effect.
results.summary: Performs the unit's melee attack: locates the melee marker, resolves the target via a hit test, and applies melee damage to it.

results.name: unit_melee_attack_scan
results.evidence: Performs a 5x5 grid of hit tests (FUN_00505880, flag 0x1000e9) around the unit's aim direction, tracks the closest hit surface (decal via FUN_004ffde0) or unit target, then applies damage to the best candidate via object_apply_damage and plays a material hit effect (FUN_0056f210); structurally parallel to unit_cause_melee_damage.
results.summary: Sweeps a small grid of hit tests in front of the unit to find the nearest melee target or surface, then applies damage or a decal accordingly.

results.name: unit_can_see_point
results.evidence: Existing name matches the module's own naming pass and is structurally plausible from the visible portion: an iterative nested-loop line-trace calling object_apply_damage and FUN_00571cb0 depending on the traced surface's team/type, consistent with a visibility/line-of-sight raycast helper (function body is largely register-resident and only partially legible without a full pack.py dump).
results.summary: Tests line-of-sight/visibility from the unit to a target point, applying any resulting effects along the trace.

results.name: unit_melee_lunge_damage_tick
results.evidence: Gated on melee-state field 0x289=='\x04' (the same field cleared to 0 by unit_cause_melee_damage) and a valid held weapon (0x294); computes a swept damage plane (matrix4x3_transform_plane after FUN_00504f60/FUN_00504e10) and applies periodic damage via object_apply_damage while decrementing a countdown byte at 0x28a.
results.summary: Applies a periodic melee/lunge damage tick while the unit is in melee sub-state 4, using a swept collision plane test.

results.name: unit_exit_seat_end
results.evidence: Existing name is plausible: computes an exit-collision plane (FUN_00504f60 + matrix4x3_transform_plane) based on the vehicle/seat object and applies damage (object_apply_damage) using its attachment/weapon id (offset 0x294/0x11c), consistent with a 'crushed while exiting a seat' check.
results.summary: Checks for and applies collision/crush damage when a unit finishes exiting a vehicle seat.

results.name: unit_process_melee_special_interaction
results.evidence: Branches on the target's weapon-tag flag bits (offset 0x17c: 0x2000 vs 0x1000) to either trigger melee damage (FUN_0056f2d0) plus a network notify (FUN_004f5bd0), or to attach this unit onto the target (object_attach_to_object) after walking its biped parent-chain — consistent with special melee 'grab'/finishing interactions between unit types.
results.summary: Handles special melee interactions between two units based on weapon-tag flag bits: either applying bonus melee damage or attaching the attacking unit onto its target.

results.name: unit_detach_from_parent
results.evidence: Existing name matches: calls object_attach_to_object (effectively detaching, given the null-ish stack args) then clears the 'attached' flag (bit 0x20 on field 4) and sets bit 0x8000 on field 0x204, followed by FUN_00569a20(1,0) — the counterpart of the attach logic seen in FUN_0056ff40.
results.summary: Detaches the unit from its current parent/attachment object.

results.name: unit_get_custom_animation_time_remaining
results.evidence: Only valid while the unit's control state (0x2a3) is 0x1c (the custom-animation state entered by unit_start_user_animation); computes the remaining frame count from the animation graph (via fields 0xcc/0xd0) minus the current frame (0xd2), matching the animation fields written by FUN_0056ebd0 (unit_set_custom_animation).
results.summary: Returns the number of frames remaining in the unit's currently playing custom animation.

results.name: unit_set_custom_animation_frame
results.evidence: Validates the custom-animation state via FUN_005702a0 (unit_start_user_animation) and, if param_2 is a valid frame index for the active graph, writes it to the frame field (0xd2).
results.summary: Sets the current playback frame of the unit's active custom animation, if valid.

results.name: unit_start_user_animation
results.evidence: Contains the exact string "the animation '%s' doesn't exist in the graph '%s'" cited by the cea-pdb hint for unit_start_user_animation (the address this name was previously mis-assigned to, 0x5739a0, contains unrelated vehicle-hover physics code); sets the custom-animation state (0x2a3=0x1c) and fields (0xcc/0xd0/0xd2) via FUN_0056ebd0, then calls object_recalculate_bounding_radius_recursive.
results.summary: Starts (or validates continuation of) a named custom animation on the unit, switching it into custom-animation control state.

results.name: unit_accumulate_clamped_offset
results.evidence: Adds param_1 (relative to the value already stored) into a persistent float accumulator at unit+0x2e8, clamped to +/-0.3 change per call — a generic rate-limited smoothing update with no further identifying context in this file.
results.summary: Applies a rate-limited (max 0.3/tick) update to a persistent smoothing value stored on the unit.

results.name: unit_find_weapon_index_with_fixed_flag
results.evidence: Scans the 4 weapon slots (0x2f8) for one whose weapon-tag flags dword (offset 0x308) has bit 3 set, mirroring the parameterized flag scan in FUN_00570520 (unit_find_weapon_index_by_flag).
results.summary: Finds the index of the first carried weapon whose tag flags have a specific fixed bit (bit 3) set, or 0xffff if none.

results.name: unit_set_throw_aim_direction
results.evidence: Only when the unit has no parent (offset 0x11c==-1), copies a 2-component direction (in_ECX) into fields 0x74/0x78 (aim direction), zeroes 0x7c, and copies a global up-vector (PTR_DAT_00696720) into 0x80-0x88; called from unit_begin_throw_grenade after computing the throw direction.
results.summary: Records the unit's grenade-throw aim direction and reference up-vector, unless the unit is currently seated in something.

results.name: unit_find_weapon_index_by_flag
results.evidence: Scans the 4 weapon slots (0x2f8) for a weapon whose tag flags dword (offset 0x308) has bit `param_1` set, the parameterized counterpart of FUN_00570460.
results.summary: Finds the index of the first carried weapon whose tag flags have the given bit set.

results.name: unit_enter_stunned_state
results.evidence: Drops the unit's current weapon (FUN_0056dec0), sets flags 0x204|=0x80 and adjusts 0x106 bits, and — if not already stunned (byte 0x28b==0) — picks a random stun duration (0x28b), records a related object id (0x410=param_1), and kicks off the random idle-turn wander (FUN_00570650), matching a 'unit becomes disoriented/stunned and drops its weapon' sequence.
results.summary: Puts the unit into a disoriented/stunned state: drops its current weapon, sets stun flags, and starts a randomized turn-wander with a randomized stun duration.

results.name: unit_initialize_random_turn_angle
results.evidence: Runs once per activation (guarded by flag bit 0x2000000 on field 0x204), sets angle field 0x414 from the unit's current velocity heading (fpatan) or 0 if stationary/incapable (FUN_004287a0), then perturbs it with a small random offset (DAT_00719cd0 PRNG) — consumed by FUN_00570840's random-turn update loop.
results.summary: One-time initialization of the unit's random idle-turn target angle, seeded from its current heading plus a small random offset.

results.name: unit_update_autoaim_interaction
results.evidence: Clears interaction-related flag bits (0x204, 0x107) each call and, if a global tracked target device is set (DAT_00746fa0+0x18c), applies a damage/interaction tick to it via object_apply_damage using the unit's own attached object (object_try_and_get(0xffffffff)).
results.summary: Updates per-tick interaction flags for the unit and applies an interaction tick against a globally tracked target object if one is set.

results.name: unit_update_random_turn_angle
results.evidence: Continuously nudges the yaw/pitch angle fields (0x414/0x418) toward randomized bounds (using the DAT_00719cd0 PRNG) initialized by FUN_00570650 (unit_initialize_random_turn_angle), clamped within +/-0.209 rad pitch and a dynamic yaw bound, then applies the result via vector3d_rotate_about_axis.
results.summary: Randomly wanders the unit's idle look/turn angle each tick within clamped bounds and applies the resulting rotation.

results.name: unit_get_biped_specific_value
results.evidence: Only forwards to FUN_0055e8e0 when the unit-type field (offset 0xb4) is 0 (biped), otherwise returns 0 — a biped-only gate around an unresolved helper.
results.summary: Returns a biped-specific value (delegated to FUN_0055e8e0) only when the unit is a biped; returns 0 for other unit types.

results.name: unit_reset_control_state
results.evidence: Zeroes a contiguous block of fields from offset 0x4cc to 0x520, encompassing the turn-banking state bytes (0x4d1-0x4d3) referenced by vehicle_update and the marker-activity bitmask (0x520) read by unit_get_average_active_marker_direction — consistent with a full state reset (e.g. on possession change or respawn).
results.summary: Clears a block of the unit's control/animation-tracking state fields, resetting them to zero.

results.name: unit_get_recently_updated_flag
results.evidence: Returns bit 0x20 of the object flags field at offset 0x10; used by vehicle_update alongside a distance check (vector3d_distance > 1.5) to decide whether to force a position resync (FUN_00570de0).
results.summary: Tests whether a specific object-flags bit (0x20) is set on the unit, used to gate a network position resync.

results.name: unit_propagate_position_delta_to_children
results.evidence: Walks the unit's child-object list (0x118/0x114 links) and, for children of type biped/vehicle (flags bits 0/1 at 0xb4), adds the position delta (in_EAX vs cached basis at 0x5c/0x60/0x100) into their tracked offset fields 0x34c-0x354, then calls FUN_004f52c0.
results.summary: Propagates the unit's positional movement delta to any attached child bipeds/vehicles, updating their cached relative offsets.

results.name: unit_has_child_of_type5
results.evidence: Walks the same child-object chain (0x118/0x114) as FUN_00570cb0, returning true if any child's type flags (0xb4) has bit 5 (0x20) set.
results.summary: Returns whether the unit has any attached child object of a specific type (flag bit 5 at 0xb4).

results.name: unit_set_facing_from_index_table
results.evidence: Guarded by a global 'cinematic/lookup active' flag (DAT_00746f8c); computes an angle from an index table keyed by unit field 0x16c and applies it via FUN_004f51c0 (the same facing-set helper used by FUN_00574780/unit_update_recoil_decay), then updates flag bit 0x20 on field 4 based on whether the unit has a parent (0x8c).
results.summary: When a global cinematic/lookup mode is active, orients the unit to face a direction taken from an indexed table.

results.name: vehicle_update
results.evidence: cea-pdb hint 'vehicle_update' confirmed by full decompilation: dispatches per-vehicle-type control calculation via a switch on tag field 0x2f4 (cases 0-6 calling FUN_00572b60..FUN_00574780/FUN_00507840), applies falling/impact damage to attached children, and toggles the '~blur' motion-blur permutation based on speed (object_set_permutation_by_name).
results.summary: Per-tick update for vehicle-type units: dispatches to per-vehicle-type control/animation calculations, applies excess-speed impact damage, and updates the motion-blur permutation.

results.name: unit_throw_grenade_release
results.evidence: Existing name kept; code accumulates weighted force contributions from body markers via FUN_004d53f0 across three phases (overall count-based, a secondary marker-ratio-scaled force, and per-limb weighted forces) — consistent with computing a thrown object's total release-force distribution, though the precise grenade linkage could not be fully confirmed from this register-resident code.
results.summary: Accumulates weighted per-marker force contributions used when releasing a thrown object (e.g. a grenade) from the unit.

results.name: unit_get_tag_flag_bit7
results.evidence: Reads bit 7 of the unit tag's flags dword at offset 0x2f0 (the same field tested elsewhere in vehicle_update for bits 0x10/0x40).
results.summary: Returns a single boolean flag (bit 7 of the unit tag's flags field) describing an unidentified unit-tag property.

results.name: unit_apply_impulse_to_seat
results.evidence: Only acts when the unit is seated in something (offset 0x8c != -1): adds the input vector to accumulated position deltas (0x1a-0x1c) and, if non-zero after normalization, an angular impulse (cross product scaled by pi) into 0x23-0x25, then flags the seat dirty (field4 bit 0x20 cleared, byte 0x149=1).
results.summary: Applies a linear and angular impulse from the unit onto the object it is currently seated in (e.g. a vehicle).

results.name: unit_predict_aim_target_position
results.evidence: For certain unit sub-types (switch on offset 0x2f4, cases 0,1,4,6), projects the current position forward using a scaled offset and validates it with a collision test (FUN_00502060), writing the result and a success flag to the caller-provided vector; other cases return failure (-1).
results.summary: Attempts to compute a projected/predicted aim position in front of the unit for certain sub-types, validating line-of-clearance via a collision test.

results.name: unit_spawn_with_starting_weapons
results.evidence: Shares the `*(int*)*in_EAX==0` / FUN_004ec590 vs FUN_004ec670 dispatch pattern with FUN_0056ddb0; on the matching branch it builds a placement transform, creates a new object (object_new_with_datum_role_control, role 1), copies full position/orientation/velocity fields (0x52c-0x564) onto it, and pre-loads up to 2 named weapons into its inventory slots (0x2f8) via the same weapon-name table (PTR_DAT_00687130/PTR_DAT_00687558) used by FUN_0056ddb0.
results.summary: Script/console-callable function that spawns a new unit at a computed placement with an initial orientation/velocity and pre-equips it with up to two named weapons.

results.name: unit_record_replay_sample
results.evidence: Builds a timestamped (QueryPerformanceCounter-derived millisecond) snapshot of the unit's associated object (object_try_and_get(2)) transform/velocity fields and passes it to FUN_004ec940, incrementing a rolling sample counter (offset 0x527) — consistent with the saved-film/replay recording system.
results.summary: Records a timestamped transform/velocity snapshot of the unit's related object for the replay/saved-film system.

results.name: vector3d_clamp_length_blend
results.evidence: Pure vector-math helper with no unit-datum access: computes a direction vector between two points (with a small epsilon bias) and blends between clamp lengths param_1/param_2 via vector3d_clamp_length depending on the squared-cosine ratio between the direction and a reference vector.
results.summary: Computes a blended clamp-length value between two extremes based on the angular alignment of two vectors, then applies it via vector3d_clamp_length.

results.name: vehicle_calculate_turret_controls
results.evidence: Dispatched from vehicle_update's per-type switch (case 0); computes two wrapped angle-like accumulators (0x139/0x13a) from fields 0x135/0x137 via FUN_00628cca (a value-wrap helper), then builds a rotation-transform output consumed by FUN_00507840 when the unit's ground/parent object's physics type (offset 0x68) is 2.
results.summary: Computes the dual-axis (pitch/yaw) turret control transform for a vehicle-type unit each tick.

results.name: vehicle_calculate_steering_wheel_controls
results.evidence: Dispatched from vehicle_update (case 1); wraps a single accumulator (0x138) from field 0x135 (turn rate) via FUN_00628cca and builds a single-axis rotation quaternion (sin/cos of half-angle) fed to FUN_00507840.
results.summary: Computes a single-axis (steering-wheel-style) rotation control transform for a vehicle-type unit each tick.

results.name: vehicle_calculate_lean_controls
results.evidence: Dispatched from vehicle_update (case 2); derives a lean quaternion from the unit's angular velocity magnitude (0x1a-0x1c) and turn field 0x137, applying vector3d_rotate_about_axis and vector3d_angle_between_4cd4f0 before handing off to FUN_00507840.
results.summary: Computes a lean/tilt rotation control transform for a vehicle-type unit based on its current angular velocity.

results.name: vehicle_calculate_ground_lean_controls
results.evidence: Dispatched from vehicle_update (case 3); builds a lean/roll quaternion from the unit's turn state (0x13b/0x13c) relative to its ground/parent object's contact frame (matrix4x3_inverse + quaternion_from_matrix4x3/quaternion_to_axis_angle), applies it via FUN_00507840, then triggers the hover/jet-thruster particle effect (FUN_00574900).
results.summary: Computes ground-hugging lean/roll for a hovering vehicle each tick and triggers its hover/jet thruster particle effects.

results.name: vehicle_calculate_wing_flex_controls
results.evidence: Dispatched from vehicle_update (case 4); iterates the unit's marker/node list (count at parent object+0x68) writing per-node transforms, applying vector3d_clamp_length/matrix4x3_transform_vector using an unresolved lookup (FUN_0053ee00) to compute a bank-based sway, consistent with flexible wing/control-surface animation on a flying vehicle.
results.summary: Computes per-marker flex/sway transforms (e.g. for wing or control-surface animation) on a flying vehicle-type unit each tick.

results.name: vehicle_calculate_hover_turn_controls
results.evidence: Full decompile shows vehicle turn/steer-toward-target math (fpatan-based direction blending, gravity/lift terms) ending with a smoothed ground-contact ratio (offset 0x4ec) fed into FUN_00574bc0 (the hover-thruster particle effect) — it reads/writes no animation-time value, so the prior name 'unit_get_custom_animation_time' is incorrect; that concept is better matched by FUN_005701b0.
results.summary: Computes hovering-vehicle turn/lift physics each tick and triggers its hover-thruster particle effect; previously mis-named as an animation-time getter.

results.name: vehicle_calculate_hover_lift_toward_target
results.evidence: Nearly identical tail logic to FUN_005738b0 (same ground-contact-ratio smoothing into offset 0x4ec and final FUN_00574bc0 call) but always takes the 'aiming at a target' branch instead of first checking (unaff_ESI+0x88<=0.0); contains no animation-graph/name handling, so the prior name 'unit_start_user_animation' is incorrect — that cea-pdb string match instead belongs to FUN_005702a0.
results.summary: Variant of the hovering-vehicle lift/turn physics calculation entered when a target direction is already known, ending in the same hover-thruster effect trigger.

results.name: vehicle_calculate_mounted_controls_dispatch
results.evidence: Dispatched from vehicle_update (case 5); chooses between FUN_00574460 and FUN_00573f60 based on the sign of the ground/parent object's first float field, then always calls FUN_00574bc0 (the hover-thruster particle-effect function) afterward.
results.summary: Selects between two ground-contact lean calculations for a mounted/turret-style vehicle unit and triggers its hover-thruster effect.

results.name: vehicle_calculate_ground_contact_lean
results.evidence: Bypasses (calls FUN_00507840 directly) unless the parent/ground object's physics type (offset 0x68) equals 2; otherwise builds a lean/roll quaternion from the unit's turn-rate fields (0x135/0xce) and ground-contact orientation (matrix3x3_transpose/multiply, quaternion_from_matrix3x3) before calling FUN_00572a90 and FUN_00507840.
results.summary: Computes a ground-contact-relative lean transform for a vehicle when its supporting object's physics type is 2, otherwise passes through unchanged.

results.name: vehicle_calculate_ground_contact_lean_alt
results.evidence: Parallel structure to FUN_00573f60 (same lean/roll quaternion derivation via matrix4x3_inverse/quaternion_from_matrix4x3) but gated on a sentinel float check on the ground object rather than an explicit type field, and writes its resulting transform into a caller-supplied buffer (param_2) instead of a fixed local buffer.
results.summary: Alternate ground-contact lean calculation for a vehicle, writing its resulting transform into a caller-provided buffer.

results.name: unit_update_recoil_decay
results.evidence: Decrements a recoil countdown timer at offset 0x4ce, decays a position-offset pair (0x68-0x70 and 0x8c-0x94) by a fixed 0.835 factor each tick, optionally re-orienting it via matrix4x3_from_axis_angle/matrix4x3_transform_vector, and applies the result through FUN_004f51c0 — matching vehicle_update's call site `if (0 < unit->0x4ce) { FUN_00574780(); FUN_00575170(); }`.
results.summary: Decays the unit's camera/weapon recoil offset toward zero each tick while its recoil countdown timer is active.
